workload.note: Rookie; no 2025 NFL workload. Played college ball at Arkansas in 2025 (previously Buffalo 2021-2023, New Mexico State 2024).

scheme.note: Raiders have an entirely new coaching staff for 2026: HC Klint Kubiak (hired Feb 9, 2026, ex-Seahawks OC) and OC Andrew Janocko (ex-Seahawks QB coach), replacing Pete Carroll who was fired after one season.

competition.name: Ashton Jeanty
competition.note: 2025 first-round rookie; led all rookies with 975 rush yds / 1,321 scrimmage yds in 2025. Firmly entrenched starter.

notes: Washington drafted in Round 4 (122nd overall) by Las Vegas in 2026 per Wikipedia; note raiders.com team article described him as 'fourth-round' as well (some other pieces reference him loosely as later-round sleeper).
raiders.com (Jul 2, 2026): projected as primary backup to Jeanty, fits Kubiak's wide-zone scheme, 'positioned to earn substantial carries.'
Yahoo Sports (Aug 9, 2026) fantasy sleeper piece: projected as 'change-of-pace back behind Jeanty' who could 'garner carries near the goal line.'

injury.note: No injury reported for Washington as of Aug 11, 2026 in sources checked.

camp.quote: Unique blend of size, speed and explosiveness... fits the wide zone system.
Change-of-pace back behind Jeanty and garner carries near the goal line.
